description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Aurelia that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the oldest Aurelia into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aurelia token enters the battlefield, Aetherstorm Roc, Decoction Module and Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Declare the Aurelia token as an attacker. The token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
